usage: 半米 bun3 mai5 is used to describe a length of half a meter.
You can use 半米 to refer to measurements in everyday life, such as fabric or room dimensions.
半米 works as a noun and can be used alone or with numbers for specifying quantity.
In casual conversations, 半米 may refer to approximate length rather than exact measurement.
You can combine 半米 with classifiers like 㗎 or 單位, but it often stands alone as a unit of measurement.
